milestone: Music+: validator identity challenges and upcoming album GEN pools
status: Verified release and walkthrough prepared; owner uploads the video and submits. Not submitted automatically.
summary: Bullseye Music+ lets album fans forecast real upcoming Billboard 200 outcomes and stake simulated StudioNet GEN. A creator lists a plain-English question; independent validators compile it, then judge bonded identity challenges before staking opens. They can uphold, amend only through code-generated options, or void the market. The update preserves original Film contracts, prior Music results and native payouts, and combines free predictions in one season. Historical test cases remain clearly separate from competition.
judgmentPoints: New judgment: interpret a fixed archived Billboard report, compiled album identity and frozen release evidence. Validators independently fetch and rerun the verdict, compare bounded amendment IDs and evidence digests, and verify the leader’s exact quoted passages in their own fetches. Album replacement is impossible; week, edition and bin amendments are code generated. Challenger arguments and pages are untrusted data. Compilation and later chart-row identification remain separate judgment points. Code enforces money, hashes, finality and deadlines.
reviewRules: Default 24-hour pre-stake review; this StudioNet demonstration explicitly uses ten minutes and a two-hour decision deadline. Listing deposit 0.004 GEN; challenge bond 0.001 GEN; amendment reward 0.001 GEN from the deposit. One challenge per ground, one active case. UPHELD assigns the bond to the creator; AMENDED returns bond plus reward; VOIDED refunds every original deposit and never opens; insufficient evidence returns the bond. Expiry fallback is labelled, never counted as a validator verdict. Credits use verified pull withdrawals.
network: StudioNet 61999. Native GEN is simulated development currency. No production-chain or real-money wagering claim.

contracts.name: BullseyeMusicChallenges
contracts.description: Bonded pre-stake identity judgment against a fixed archived Billboard reference and frozen release evidence. Independent validators rerun verdicts and verify quoted passages. Code bounds amendments, deadlines, refunds and receipt-verified pull withdrawals.

contracts.name: BullseyeMusicMarketsV2
contracts.description: Compiles album questions, enforces the approved identity hash and challenge gate, and resolves archived complete Billboard 200 charts after observation. Reissues explicitly use chart position instead of a second debut. No administrator supplies a winner.

contracts.name: BullseyeMusicPoolsV2
contracts.description: Accepts 0.01–100 simulated GEN, freezes finalized source hash and deadlines, distributes the entire winning pool proportionally and refunds void/empty-winning/overdue sources. Failed native transfers retain recoverable claims; paid requires exact independently verified credit. No LLM.

contracts.name: BullseyeSeasonsV2
contracts.description: Imports finalized Film, new Music and previous Music free predictions into one season. Correct ranges, bounded exact-rank closeness and chronological streaks are derived in code. Historical exhibition stays separate from competitive forecasts. No stakes or LLM.

challengeProofs.ruleQuote: Aiding Lover’s first week: the set’s release in four collectible deluxe CD editions at Target, as well as dozens of merchandise/digital album bundles sold through Swift’s official website. The album also had a standard CD edition that was available widely at retail, along with an equivalent digital album that was available via all digital retailers.

The Billboard 200 chart ranks the most popular albums of the week in the U.S. based on multi-metric consumption as measured in equivalent album units. Units are comprised of traditional album sales, track equivalent albums (TEA) and streaming equivalent albums (SEA). The new Sept. 7-dated chart (where Lover enters at No. 1) will be posted in full on Billboard's websites on Wednesday, Sept. 4 (one day later than usual, due to the Labor Day holiday in the U.S. on Sept. 2).
challengeProofs.evidenceQuote: Surrender is the second studio album by American indie pop singer-songwriter Maggie Rogers, released on July 29, 2022, by Debay Sounds and Capitol Records. It follows the release of her debut studio album, Heard It in a Past Life (2019).

challengeProofs.ruleQuote: Biggest Overall Week for an Album Since Swift’s Last Album, reputation: As Lover starts with 867,000 equivalent album units earned, it logs the biggest single week for any album, in terms of units, since Swift’s last album, reputation. It debuted with 1.238 million equivalent album units earned in the week ending Nov. 16, 2017 (and bowed at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 chart dated Dec. 2 of that year).
